agents.name: ORION
agents.label: Volume spike on a green candle
agents.rule: volume >= 3x its 20-bar average, green body >= 50% of range

agents.name: VEGA
agents.label: Hanging man
agents.rule: hammer shape after a 5-bar rise

agents.name: NOVA
agents.label: Hammer
agents.rule: after a 5-bar drop; lower wick >= 2x body; upper wick <= 10% of range; body >= 5% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: ATLAS
agents.label: Big green candle (momentum ignition)
agents.rule: green, range >= 2x the prior ATR, body >= 60% of range

agents.name: LYRA
agents.label: Spinning top
agents.rule: body 10-30% of range, both wicks >= the body

agents.name: TITAN
agents.label: Five green candles in a row
agents.rule: 5 consecutive green closes

agents.name: AEGIS
agents.label: Five green candles in a row
agents.rule: 5 consecutive green closes

agents.name: HELIOS
agents.label: Shooting star
agents.rule: inverted-hammer shape after a 5-bar rise

agents.name: SIRIUS
agents.label: MFI above 80
agents.rule: MFI(14) crosses above 80

agents.name: KEPLER
agents.label: Volume spike on a green candle
agents.rule: volume >= 3x its 20-bar average, green body >= 50% of range

agents.name: POLARIS
agents.label: Close above the upper Bollinger band
agents.rule: close crosses above BB(20,2) upper band (breakout reading)

agents.name: RIGEL
agents.label: Doji after a drop
agents.rule: after a 5-bar drop; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: CYGNUS
agents.label: Close above the upper Bollinger band
agents.rule: close crosses above BB(20,2) upper band (breakout reading)

agents.name: DRACO
agents.label: MFI above 80
agents.rule: MFI(14) crosses above 80

agents.name: PULSAR
agents.label: Bearish engulfing
agents.rule: after a 5-bar rise; green then red whose body covers the green body

agents.name: QUASAR
agents.label: Big green candle (momentum ignition)
agents.rule: green, range >= 2x the prior ATR, body >= 60% of range

agents.name: ZENITH
agents.label: Outside bar, up close
agents.rule: range covers the prior bar and closes above the prior high

agents.name: AURORA
agents.label: Inside bar breakdown
agents.rule: an inside bar, then a close below the mother bar's low

agents.name: BOREAS
agents.label: OBV new high before price
agents.rule: OBV at a 20-bar high while the close is not

agents.name: CALYPSO
agents.label: Doji after a rise
agents.rule: after a 5-bar rise; body <= 10% of range; range >= 0.5 ATR

agents.name: CASSINI
agents.label: Inside bar
agents.rule: high below and low above the prior bar's

agents.name: CEPHEUS
agents.label: Breakout confirmed by OBV
agents.rule: close and OBV both at new 20-bar highs

agents.name: ELARA
agents.label: Breakout confirmed by OBV
agents.rule: close and OBV both at new 20-bar highs

agents.name: EOS
agents.label: Donchian 20 breakout
agents.rule: close above the prior 20-bar high

agents.name: GAIA
agents.label: Donchian 20 breakout
agents.rule: close above the prior 20-bar high

exits: limit 0.1% under the close (3 bars), stop 4x ATR of the timeframe, one exit at 2R, 96h, NDAX fees
